record_scope_reconstruction: Truck access at Chaman–Spin Boldak was interrupted by protests affecting the border crossing and the main highway from Chaman. A gate marker can identify the affected crossing but cannot locate every highway blockade.

source_checks.finding: 24 January 2024 Logistics Cluster update confirms continued closure to trucks and obstruction of the main national highway from Chaman.
March 2024 account names Chaman–Spin Boldak goods-trade restoration; photograph identifies Friendship Gate.

date_scope_check.finding: Geography review only. Current phase bounds, traffic exceptions, uncertain onset, reopening status and >24-hour decision are retained; current map features are not evidence of historical operation.
date_scope_check.qualification: SA013-D1: The January 24 logistics update reports restricted trucks and blocked highway access. Radio Pakistan and Arab News report resumed goods trade by March 3; this is a later-access bound, not an exact first reopening or proof that every truck category had resumed. The interval between the two observations is unresolved. July 22–23 photo captions document passengers and continued document checks, so they do not date the freight restoration. The broader protest continued; its duration is not a continuous nine-month commercial closure.
